reviews.review_description: Daniel the sales rep was incredibly helpful and honest, letting us know about the solar battery rebate that had been announced when we did not know about it. Decided to go ahead with the installation regardless and are super happy with it so far.The only hiccup that occured during the whole process was that the installation date didn't get communicated to us untill the day before when the Installation team leader called. He was incredibly apologetic and explained I should have received an email 2 weeks prior. It was his belief that due to the chaos caused by the battery rebate being announced prior to the state election with a commencement date after the election many people were cancelling or putting their orders on hold and the administration staff were swamped.Installers were incredibly helpful and friendly, one of the guys even offered to buy us a beer at the local pub when we ran into them there. After the install was complete on day 2 the installer ran through the system tests with me to show us how the system would work when back up power came online, showed me where all the breakers, isolators and conponents were located and what I would need to show any electricians in future. He also helped me set up the app, get it connected to the system and ran me through it.We are very happy with the Sigen System with 5kw inverter, 8kwh battery and 10kw of panels producing more than enough power to run the house during the day and most of the night depending on what we are using. The MySigen app is very user friendly with easy to understand insights into our power usage. Combined with ease of adjusting settings and the modularity of the system has been very helpful with getting the most out of it.
Quoting was goodInstallation was timely and cleanAll connected ready to go once installed, brief overview of the system by installer

The Sunwise energy team were exceptional from start to finish.We dealt with a gentleman called Daniel who was amazing. He listened to our needs and looked over several quotes from other companies, he was truthful and honest, to which was refreshing considering the lies and pushy sales from other so called leading companies.Daniel visited our home and recommended a product that was perfect for our needs, we ended up spending a little more than what we wanted however this was totally worth it as the system is perfect for future upgrades etc.Daniel and his team was overall exceptional from the initial phone call to the installation.If you want a company who is genuine, honest and reliable then purchase through Sunwise energy, you won't be disappointed.Amazing, if I could give 7 stars I would!
As I said before, the sales/quoting process went well. As you know this is a difficult time of year for the construction but all is moving forward.
reviews.battery_brand: Sigenergy Optimised 8kwh HV Lithium Ion Phosphate (Other)

reviews.review_description: I live in WA the system i installed is located on west facing roof. There are no impediments to sun access until 6pm when sun drops below next door roof line. However between 3pm and 4pm the power production drops dramatically and continues to fall until 6pm when sun drops behind neighbours roof line. These was even evident on the summer solstice day.the system starts producing at near full capacity (1.9kw) at 10:30 but drops like a stone from 3-4 each day even in our current blue sky blazing sun weather.I am happy with overall performance (32-40 kWh) but at 3:30pm solar buyback rate drops from 10cents/kwh to 2 cents /kwh at this time. Have asked installer to explain but has no idea

The sales/quoting service was excellent, with easy one-on-one interactions (phone or SMS) with the sales person, who ultimately provided 4 or 5 different variations.Their were a couple of minor hiccups with the installation, mainly resulting from their office scheduling system that led to last minute adjustments of the timing. However, the field staff were outstanding, polite, efficient conscientious at completing the installation etc. It turned out that the Sigenergy system was relatively new to them, resulting in a couple of teething problems to establish communication, but the staff returned the following day to complete. Overall layout (slight adjustments made on site, after discussion with us) and neatness of the installation were top rate.Customer service has also been very good, once you know which section (or staff) within the company to contact. Most of the explanations on use of the system came from the lead installer, but he communicated very well. We have yet to use the EV charger (awaiting changing our car), but no reason to expect any problems.
Prompt quote, good communication, installers were punctual, friendly, polite, tidy and showed me how to install app. Process was very easy.

I'm greatly satisfied with the level of expertise and customer service. The pricing is also competitive. After 3 weeks installed, the system seems to be working fine as per the Fronius app monitoring system.
Sales and quoting was factual and promptThe instal was tidy and efficient and even done on a sundayThe after service was good and concise
Sales quote greatInstallation greatCustomer service great but communication needs a little work

We are still ironing out some problems caused by a lack of understanding of our site. We are three phase and the addition of a battery exposed a lack of knowledge in the installer and the manufacturer of how the equipment works, it's limitations and local power supply by-laws. That said, the staff of both organisations have been excellent in explaining and fixing glitches and genuinely seem to be aiming for the best outcome.

Technician was doing a requested circuitry modification and noticed the LG battery (3years old) was swelling and isolated it.Sunwise assisted me throughout the LG refund process and replaces the battery and inverter with a Solar Edge system.

The Sunwise team were professional from the quoting process right through to installation day. No pressure during the quote (not sales) process. On install day they were early on the job, decommissioned my old system and installed the new system and left the area in a clean state. They were happy to chat and explain things during the install and finally during commissioning went through the monitoring app set up.

We installed a Q Cells DC system, 23 panels, inverter, 3 batteries and monitoring using Switchdin Stormcloud. i asked for Solar Analytics and was told I didnt need it. 2 and a bit years later and the monitoring has failed.. I cannot get the most basic responses from Sunwise I had to ask to be CC;d into the emails to Q Cells. I also asked for a quote for Solar Anayltics thinking that upgrading would be viable when repairs are conducted. Whenever that may be. I still havent got the quote 2 weeks after asking. Today after communication with my energy provider it was determined that the system is not generatiing correctly. Given that I reported an issue with the system monitoring i would have thought a site visit may have been a given. Clearly not. Afterr sales service and assistance is non existant. Today in an email one of their management criticised me and was dismissive of my issues with the system.. The individual concerned attributed comments that had not been made about a staff member in a somewhat heated phone conversation due to the lack of response to emails. Management would not accept my call and were unwilling to address the warranty issue.

Everything went smoothly....installation on the day as advised. The winter weather proved challenging so the installers had to work around the showers as the roof was not safe when wet.I added the smart meter to the job and love the information it feeds back on the app.

Out of the five quotes that we got, Sunwise was the provider who detailed numerous options, explained which options were possible and those that would not work for our needs. The installation process was simple and well explained. This company is local (Capel) and had great customer service and fast communication, all they way from quote through to install. I would highly recommend getting a quote from Sunwise.
A quality system, tailored to our current and future needs

Mike little rang for an appointment to start the process. Arrived on time one minute early.Went thro the process and checked out my summary for the past 3 years and advised the size required.Advised a quote would be in my hands within 24 hrs. This was done.All paper work for the quote,the installation, the grid connection, and the App on the mob phone installed by the site all doneAs a note your information regarding the size of the system and comments on the smallest system available which is not installed and the smallest being 3.6kw leaves me with a discussion with Synergy regarding an upgrade from the 2kw of 13yrs ago to the smallest available now. They indicated because I UPGRADED there will not be any feed in tariff payments. Typical of the WA State Government cop out excuse. I will follow up with my member of Parliament to their attitude of exclusion.Once again many help for your advice of replacing the existing solar system

sales quoting purpose was efficient and detailed.  Actual quoted panels were not available so had to accept slightly lower rated panels  THe installation was excellent, but there was some delay with hooking up the system to the App to be able to monitor.  Overall price was about $2500 more than expected, from all three companies.  I guess we get used to paying more in regional areas.

I highly recommend this company for your solar needs. From the initial consult and needs analysis, system design and clear detailed quote. Through to a clean organised well labelled install quickly and cleanly. Very happy with the service provided by this company, a tribute to its staff.

The SunWise Energy team from Daniel at quotation, Josh and his teams at installation along with all the admin staff were terrific - informative, helpful and friendly.  Very smooth upgrade from my old system to a great new Fronius Gen 24 Plus which has consumption monitoring which I am finding very interesting and helpful.  Communication was excellent at every stage.  I would highly recommend SunWise - thanks team.

This is our second system supplied & installed by Sunwise Energy and both have been an easy & well-informed experience. All staff have been friendly, knowledgeable and professional in all aspects of the process.Would be more than happy to refer Sunwise Energy to any of my family or friends.
Quoting process was very good installation timeline was excellent. Installation was very professional.

The install was smooth but now that you have to have wifi connected, if you ever have to change your wifi password on the unit, you're out of luck. I didnt want to create any drama with sunwise, getting a sample "customer" password to get into the fronius Gen24 portal to update your wifi password forget it. I update my Wifi password but the system is not straight forward, you have to have an online log in. I was told if you want to update your password you will need to call out sunwise every time.Im tech savvy so if your not might be ok but I live to know that when i buy something, I have full control of it.For this unit with Sunwise you own it but you dont own it if you get my drift.I feel like ripping it off the wall.

Our neighbours recommended Sunwise Energy and we are very happy we took their advice.  We had been researching solar for some time and had lots of questions about systems, panels, batteries etc.  Also some confusion, so it was great to sit down with Mike and have an in depth conversation.  He was very practical and down to earth and explained the technical side of things plainly and in an easy  to understand format.From their it was easy to choose a system.The set up was  over 1.5 days and went very smoothly with a professional and friendly crew.  Despite the weather being awful.We were also particularly concerned to make sure we were dealing with an organisation that had longevity and good after sales service,The customer service was excellent and we have already recommended them to another neighbour

Sunwise gave us all the different options, other companies only provided one option. The system we chose takes into consideration our distance from the ocean and also our preference for a system not made in China.
Salesman easy to deal with; I was kept up to date all the way through the process; installation was on time and efficient.

Sales rep was great - explained the lot. Workers were punctual and polite, knew their job and got it done quickly. Only set back was that they ran out of ordered panels and were advised only the morning job was to be done. Went to a slightly larger panel and is running well.

From the very first visit from Sunwise, I knew these guys were the ones to go to for Solar panel installation. Very professional Very helpful and fabulous to deal with. Their after service communication was very reassuring so I know I have made the right choice. Sales process excellent. Installation faultless. Customer service fabulous.

Great Information from the site visit explaining which system would suite our needs.Once we gave the go ahead the office staff kept us update of the installation steps great work.One week later installation team arrived on time and did a great job.Thank you Sunwise for the experience.

I engaged with SunWise based on them being local and having high review results here. The consultation was great, the rep was knowledgable and we discussed options at length to find a system which met out needs and hit the target price point. Their quote was competitive and all communication was prompt and simple. Installers came out and did the install over two days with next to no impact at all, very polite and professional crew! We had some initial trouble with a misconfiguration of the inverter which prevented the system from exporting to the grid making the system operate in a consumption constrained model instead of reaching full potential. Within a week the team had addressed the issue and had the system working perfectly. I am a very happy customer and would highly recommend them to family, friends and others!
Quick process from site review thru quotation to deposit and installation
Very professional business, friendly staff from the installers to office workers. Great experience.

I contacted Sunwise Energy who did the original installation and they sent a technician around in a couple of days. Found the inverter faulty and as it was still under warranty did all the chasing up with the manufacturer and installed the new replacement unit.Very happy with their friendly service.
Helpful staff, fast friendly quote and quality, fast installation. Couldn't be happier.

Sales and quotes were friendly and not pushy.  Price was competitive with other quotes, but quite a bit more than a similar system installed in Perth - the hidden costs of living in the Regions?  On the other hand, it was a difficult install which they coped with well. They were very punctual and tidy   I'd have liked a bit more of a hand over, but they are available any time for questions - being local a big plus for me.

Great experience from start to finish.A company that knows it's products, cares for its customers, delivers on expectations and is so very easy to deal with.It is one of those situations where a company didn't need my business, but they wanted it.Post installment the support has been perfect, accessible, informative, but not in your face.Highly recommend Sunwise to anyone installing solar.

The sales/quoting process was great and very informative.We were not pressured in to purchasing any system.Installation was great,team done a fantastic job and showed lots of pride in their work.Customer service was very good and efficient,they contacted Western power and arranged everything for us.

We received a very professional install by a well organised team of installers who were punctual ,friendly and courteous, all gear was fitted as we expected .At the finish all the packaging was cleaned up and taken with them and the area left neat and tidy.Well done SunWiseGeoff

A very professional off grid  install. The team was experienced, friendly, and a wealth of knowledge. And the final product was neat, tidy  and looks great.I would highly recommend them.The system its self is awesome.Thank you Sunwise.

Very helpful sales team assisted in insurance claim and assisted in the system required for my circumstances. The installation process was very smooth the installers were very polite and on time and helpful after the install was complete. Would definitely recommend sunwise to family and friends.

The quotes Daniel was very helpful with good guidance. The installers led by Brad where exceptional. Friendly , quick ,quality of work was exceptional. But what is the best is that the after support is exceptional, helping an old person understand the system and get us connected to the net. A big thank you to the team,very much appreciated.
The whole process with SunWise from Mike’s visit and very prompt quote, the administration team and the installers were an absolute pleasure to deal with. A very smooth process. Thank you.

Aftercare is pathetic. Not returning any emails, phone calls or messages excuses after excuses as to why they cannot talk to me or return calls guessing they know they are in the wrong for putting too many panels on our shed, which anytime can collapse.
I was impressed with everything from start to finish. Prompt, efficient informative and very helpful.Can't fault Sunwise, Brilliant.And a big thankyou to you, you made it easier and stress free ?

The sales person was well informed, polite, patient and did not try a hard sell.He was happy to supply referrals but after many questions some from your information I decided to go ahead and the installers and installation went very smoothly.Because of Xmas & NY the electricity company have not been out yet to connect but I am looking forward to it happening

The team at Sunwise were great to deal with. Whether it was Mike and our questions around the different types of systems on offer or our specific requirements, or the administration and accounting staff answering other questions or sorting out accounts with us. They were all pleasant, professional and knowledgable. Installation was booked for a specific date at our request and then rescheduled when we couldn't get an internet connection organised in time with no fuss. Grid connection was all sorted, and getting into our Solar Edge account was a breeze.

Very professional and reliable company who are outstanding in their commitment to friendly customer service. Our initial inquiry was followed up promptly with a site visit where our power needs were assessed and a detailed quote provided. We were offered a quality product specifically designed for our location and roof layout, without being over designed to boost the quote bottom line.Delivery and installation was very prompt with the end result being very tidy, could not be happier!

Yep from the ladies at the office and the boss man was also down to earth to the crew who put it up who were relaxed and new what they were doing was over all a pleasant experience and all the sun wise team are eager to assist and answer questions.
Sales person knowledgeable. Installation good but forgot to put all structures on the antenna so it fell down and broke one panel.  The grid installation was very slow.

The whole process was fantastic, from asking for quote, applying for a payment plan, to the installation and setting up.  Happy to have chosen Sunwise for my solar install as their staff and crew were polite and accommodating.  They were easy to deal with.  Will definitely recommend Sunwise to my friends considering Solar Install.

The salesman sat down and evaluated our needs and our usage, past and future then recommended a system that would suit us; not a system that was overkill and suited him.The installation was seamless and professional. A quick tutorial on how to use the inverter App was provided and it was all done.Sunwise notified the authorities of the update and Western Power changed the meter about 2 weeks later.We’ve had no problems so far and are happy with the job Sunwise have done.

The first install was scheduled with an email confirming the date and time (7am). I had to leave to go to work at 8.15 and still no installers. 8.35 I get a call asking in anyone would be on site. Poor start. They just installed the panels on the roof.Second install was scheduled to fit the 8kW Inverter. The installers had only been told that they would be connecting the wifi, they didn’t have the Inverter.Third install scheduled and then canceled at the last minute as the company still didn’t have the 8kW Inverter, another day off work.Forth install scheduled and canceled for a later date as the Inverter wasn’t in the warehouse.The fifth install went ahead, albeit the installer had to leave site as he didn’t have a 3 phase RCD, it’s a 3 phase install? Two hours lost!

The sales person seemed like the most technically competent one. Unfortunately the weather and high winds delayed the install, and the crew were called out to an emergency during the install, however this was completely out of their hands. When the weather improved and cars stopped knocking power poles over, the install went ahead very well. Tidy work and cleanup was good.

We were very happy with the whole process. From our enquiry, through to planning & installation. Sunwise Energy has a great team with fantastic service from all involved. We would highly recommend to anyone considering Solar to contact them.

After some supply delays the customer service has been excellent and their advice on my requirements was greatly appreciated. Very impressed with how effective the system and the battery have been to supply my household electricity needs even when it’s raining.

From the start Sunwise proved to be efficient and proactive.  Upon contacting them a competetive provisional quote was provided followed shortly thereafter by a site visit and confirmation of the quoted price.  Technical queries were responded to professionally and there was no hard sell.  The final price was very competetive.  The installation process was extremely quick and efficient with no issues arising at any point.Sunwise were a pleasure to deal with from the administration staff to the sales personnel and the installation crews.  I would have no issues in recommending Sunwise to any prospective customer.

Particularly impressed by the willingness and ability of the sales representative to explain  the pros and cons of the various elements of the system which enabled me to make the most informed choices for my solar needs.The installation crew were punctual, polite, friendly, tidy and unobtrusive. A problem with the suggested panel placement was immediately identified by the supervisor and referred to me. The matter was sorted immediately. It is always good to know that the crew are thinking and not merely blindly following instructions. The job, including tidy up and a comprehensive demonstration of the system reporting app, was completed hours ahead of schedule.Everything relating to grid connection was dealt with by Sunwise. We were left with nothing to do but enjoy our new system. There was a problem initially with the battery but the installer got this fixed by the battery provider  on our behalf. A truly PLATINUM job by Sunwise.
Sunwise made sure we were happy the whole way through the process

From the first contact with Sunwise energy every thing ran smoothly. The explanation for what was available was fully explained. On the day of installation the workers were prompt and polite. I was informed on what was going to happen and it ran smoothly. When the installation was finished I was given an explanation of the working of the inverter and showed how to get the app on my phone.
From the ever smiling Kiera and Loki the dog at the front desk to the awesome installers. Great experienceMany thanks to Kiera for her help with the wifi Apps.  Very much appreciated.

The process of quoting, approvals and installation went with out a problem.On the day of installation the team arrived on time, worked well as a team, cleaned up any mess and removed all rubbish.The setup was explained and any questions were answered.It was a 40 degree day,well done everyone.I will advise any one who is considering a solar system to contact Sunwise Energy, for a quote.

Very happy with our experience with Sunwise, right from the initial quote through to installation we felt everyone was honest, reliable, and professional. We are very pleased with our new system and excited to be generating our own power!

We chose Sunwise to install our new solar system as we were impressed with their industry knowledge, system recommendation and past performance reviews. The system has 22 x 390W Q-Cell panels (8.58kW PV capacity) and a 5.0kW Q-Cell hybrid inverter together with 3 x 6.3kWh batteries as backup. The installation took place earlier than anticipated, and is impressive in how it displays mounted on the wall.Communication and information with regard to the installation date was great, and Sunwise arranged for all permissions for the grid connection. The Sunwise installation team were quietly efficient, and took pride in the final presentation. They ensured that we understood how the system worked, and stressed that in the unlikely event that we required assistance, the Sunwise support team was only a phone call away.Would we recommend Sunwise for others considering a solar installation? We certainly would!

Thank you Sunwise for your knowledge and services. Right from the start, I was provided with all the information to help me choose which system would work best for me. I was kept up to date at every step of the way. The whole team was great to deal with and very professional.  What seemed a very scary and confusing task turned out to be so easy. Cheers.

Sunwise were very easy to deal with, from the initial contact, to the quote and then the installation. They were very happy to accommodate us and do the installation on a day that suited us. Sufficient employees were sent so that removal of the old system and the setting up of the new system was done very efficiently. Great products from a professional company.

The whole process from obtaining the quote through to completed installation was made easy by the different areas of the business.  They made sure I had a full and complete understanding of all components including installing the monitoring app on my phone.  On completion, other than the panels on my roof, you would not know that there had been any trades at the house.  Top notch job.  Well done.

Good Installers great people who work for Sunwise I recomend sunwise to anyone who wants to buy.Customer service was greatI had 2 CMS5000 and both had to be replaced no problem with sunwise replacing.the new Inverter replacement was a 5KW SMA (WYFI Compatible) going very wellI received a New Modem and i coudent get the WFI working i had to get Sunwise Installers to reconfiger the new modem so that i could get the information on my computer they were very prompt and had going in no time very well done, i had no idea on how to do itSunwise Energy great to deal with.

Salesman knew exactly whast i was trying to achieve, and quoted accordingly (avoiding cheap/low quality and lifetime equipment)The insall, despite some bad weather and a system software problem,  went easily and was up and running in 2 daysAll connecions and permission required were done before installation day.Excellent service by all involved

The sales team were very helpful and knew their products. The installers were on time,  neat and tidy and very professional. Everything was taken care of, new meter, grid connection and WIFI setup.Very happy with the Sunwise experience.
Fantastic prompt service. Very polite servicemen who cleaned up after themselves. Very accommodating, brilliant sales & fantastic administration service. Highly recommended

Sunrise were extremely efficient from the beginning to end. The sales person was across his subject matter and the discussion was of great benefit in deciding system choice. The Installers were punctual, efficient and very knowledgeable regarding the system that was installed , they left the site as they found it and were just a great group of tradesmen and apprentices. There workmanship was excellent. The handover and commissioning was easy to understand.

The first great thing about SunWise was that Daniel came to my home and listened to exactly what I wanted as well as answering a multitude of questions.  He designed a hybrid system that would take care of my needs for a stable temperature 24/7 throughout the year.  The SunWise office staff kept me informed of the progress towards installation and were friendly and very efficient.  On the installation day four technicians worked with perfect coordination to achieve completion in 5.5 hours.  It seemed to be a seamless operation.  Now after a fortnight of use I'm delighted with the outcome.  The 22 panels of 8.48kW capacity PV run the house, charge the batteries and feed back into the grid.  The 2 x 6.3kW Q Cell batteries  keep my heater and household utilities going throughout the evening and night time. Even on dull days the system is exporting power to the grid.  The 5kW hybrid Q Cell inverter has a screen on it that delivers the figures as well as showing me, in an animated diagram exactly where the power is flowing and in which direction.  The inverter is also wifi compatible.I love my solar system and would thoroughly recommend SunWise Energy to anyone looking for a company that's professional, reliable and understands sustainability.
Easy process from start to finish, everything explaned in depth, thank you and there local

Mike the sales consultant was excellent particularly with the quality of information provided. Although this wasn't the cheapest quote, it was the best value for the system provided. The installation team where professional and had finished in just half a day. Also can't say enough good things about the office staff's friendliness and professionalism. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a quality solar system.

I am so happy with my new solar system installed by Sunwise Energy last week.Their service was excellent all the way through.I very much appreciated their regular updates pre-installation, keeping me informed every step of the way.The guys who installed it were thorough and professional. Sunwise advised me on the best system for my needs and budget.I would not hesitate to recommend them to others.

Mike came to quote in person, was very easy answered all my questions!Installation team was amazing! I ended up having to leave and I have two dogs that are too friendly and the team looked after without hesitation!Unfortunately there was some miscommunication within the company so my racking wasn’t installed, once I noticed it was sorted within 10 minutes and the guys came back at the same week for the racking, so that was very much appreciated!!Everything was done for me including getting the inverter onto the WiFi and my account setup so I can track my production!

Had issues with western power throughout the whole process and customer service were great at calling on our behalf when things weren't running smoothly.Sunwise wasn't the cheapest quote, which they are very open about at the get go, but I really feel like a valued customer and if anything happens in the future I know well be looked after.
We had a battery and panels installed and could not be happier with the product, the installers and service.  I would recommend Sunwise to everyone.  The whole experience was excellent.

Daniel was happy to come and chat with us twice while we explored all of our options within our budget which Daniel respected.The team of installers, three, were great, they each knew their role for the day, worked well together and got the job done in good time with no fuss or mess.They were polite and Brad was more than happy to assist us with the App for our phone and laptop, which was much appreciated at the end of the day.

Professional and well informed salesman who answered questions in layman's terms.. Office staff polite, sunny and obliging.  Great PR for the business. Lovely group of boys came to install on a pretty awful wintry day and did a splendid job connecting us to the sun.  System working well. All round a top experience.  Definitely recommend.

Sunwise were able to rectify issues I had been left with by another installer. Their service and expertise has my system running now as it should have been from the beginning. Their service and quoting were very prompt and punctual and the workmanship was excellent.
Easy process from start to finish with helpful staff. Very happy with the quality of the install and speedy responses from admin.

I was extremely happy and satisfied with the customer service provided by the whole team from sunWise energy. I'll be suggesting them to anyone who asks who to go through for solar panels. Found them to be very informative and professional. Thanks again sunWise.
Great sales/quoting process Emma was very helpful which was much appreciated, thank you. the installation went well being the weather wouldn't cooperate.Customer service was very good
Prompt, professional and personable service. Thank you team for your time in understanding our service and providing us with the relevant information to allow us to make informed decisions.

Hi,To say impressed is an understatement. The complete team has been helpful, friendly, informative and most importantly, honest about the best system for us at our home.The team from the 1st phone call through to discussing quotes and then extremely quick installation was great. Best part is that the team installing the system were efficient, quick and most importantly clean.The removal of the old failed system as great as well, nothing left behind at all.Thanks for everything and yes, we will be in touch for any improvements (batteries) etc. in the future plus servicing and cleaning of the system.Why would I change from a team that offer good old fashioned customer service.Regards;Brian

Excellent from the first contact through to the installation and then the follow up from the girls in the office. Competitive prices for superior quality equipment compared to other quotes. These guys are honest and know what they are doing highly recommended.

Decided to upgrade from 1.5 to 6.6 Kw system. Sunrise adviser a Mike visited and was very helpful in providing choices of equipment, he was able to maximise our solar capture with appropriate panel placements. The installation team were very professional and arrived on time and worked continuously. The old panels were taken away so no rubbish left.System generating well and we are extremely pleased with whole process

I wanted to upgrade my 10KW Solar PV system, to include a battery around 8KW and a Fronius Smartmeter - so I contacted Sunwise Energy, who did the original PV installation a few years ago.We eventually settled on a Fronius Symo Gen 24 Hybrid 10kW Inverter, a BYD HVM 11kWhr Battery and the Fronius 3-Phase Smartmeter to meet my requirements.I placed the order with Sunwise and a few weeks later the guys arrived to install the new components.The installers were friendly, efficient and tidy.They kept me informed of progress and the power outage was kept to a minimum.The installation was completed efficiently and commissioned by the end of the day.I now have all of the details of the Solar PV, battery and associated components on my phone and Internet and can monitor the movement of energy around the system - which is great.It has already helped us manage use of high-energy appliances such as underfloor heating, washing machine, stove, etc.When almost charged, the battery feeds the house overnight and saves using power from the grid when the PV panels are inactive at night.I recommend the components I have used and Sunwise for supply and installation of them.In addition, the Fronius Solarweb site records all of the data, provides graphs and other useful information.I am very please with the outcome.

We initially had a 3 kw system installed as that was the biggest permitted by Western Power ( because of grid infrastructure limits ). Upgraded over a year later by Sunwise to a battery setup and more panels which has over come the limits imposed by the 3 kw system.I can recommend this kind of installation to anybody with a higher power consumption. Even to the point where we are considering another battery to get us through days of low sun.  Both installations went smoothly and broken roof tiles were replaced by the boys. Also fitted an emergency generator power socket. More recently we were notified by Sunwise that a panel was not producing due to a faulty part which was replaced free of charge. Last week we advised Sunwise about a roof leak and also that our battery backup was not kicking in during a power outage. They sent a crew out next day and sorted both problems.Their representatives are always pleasant to deal with, and a big thanks to the fellas for getting up on the roof on a wet day when I wouldn't have expected it. The Backup problem was sorted with a system reset which brad guided me through so hopefully I can do it if needed in the future.
Could not fault the service from quoting to installation. Very professional.

We have been happily living with an off the grid solar system installed by Sunwise Energy 5 years ago. They have always given great support, both over the phone and on the infrequent times they've needed to come onsite. They dont expect you to be a expert but never treat you like an idiot, and they make a point of explaining what they're doing  and why, so you know how to manage your system.Recently, we began to have some trouble that was tricky to diagnose. Glen stuck at it, on a daily basis, liasing with the manufacturers, to identify the problem and then work out solutions.
